evals.name: mixed-types-grouped-in-order
evals.prompt: Use the note-formatter skill to format the release-note bullets in files/mixed-list.txt.
evals.expected_output: Six lines, grouped FEAT, FIX, DOCS, CHORE, with input order kept inside each group.
assertions: Output has exactly one line per input bullet (6 lines)
Both FEAT lines come first, in input order: dark mode, then markdown export
Both FIX lines come next, in input order: empty input crash, then summary total
The DOCS line comes after the FIX lines
Each summary is sentence case with no trailing period and at most 60 characters

evals.name: missing-issue-number-renders-none
evals.prompt: Use the note-formatter skill to format the release-note bullet in files/no-issue.txt.
evals.expected_output: One line: - [FIX] Typo in the error message for missing files (#none)
assertions: The summary is sentence case with no trailing period
